envs.description: List of environment variable assignments. Each object must have 'name' and 'value' fields.

items.description: This is a placeholder for the schema definition of list items, not a runtime variable. I will define the structure in the `items` property of the list vars.

window_delay.description: Optional delay in milliseconds for window size changes.

window_min_delay.description: Minimum delay in milliseconds to force wait regardless of program options.

client_args.description: Arguments to pass to the client program.

steps.description: List of interaction steps to perform after start. Each object must have 'type' and other relevant fields.
